fail_to_pass: an exact version, with or without an equals sign, and build metadata never counts
caret ranges keep the leftmost non-zero part fixed
tilde ranges fix the minor part when it is given
a comparator with a partial version means the whole family it names
hyphen ranges include both ends, and a partial upper end means the whole family
alternatives with || each stand on their own, and an empty alternative means any version
a prerelease satisfies a set only when one of its comparators names a prerelease of the same major.minor.patch
with includePrerelease a prerelease is judged by its place in the order alone
prerelease precedence follows semver 2.0: numbers by value, names by text, numbers before names, a shorter list before a longer one, a prerelease before its release
maxSatisfying gives the highest version in the range, the first of equals, and null when none
a version has to be exactly major.minor.patch with an optional prerelease and build: nothing else is accepted
a range has to be made of the forms above: anything else is refused with the range as it was given
the highest version in a range
a bad version is refused with the text in the message
